2301240.name: Mutter
2301240.about_the_game:
Meet Maddox Holloway, a 9-year-old boy in rural England, 1940. With his father at the front lines of World War II, a dark affliction slowly consumes his mother, twisting her into something monstrous. Mutter follows Maddox’s harrowing struggle as he faces fear, suffering, and a crushing sense of responsibility, confronting the creature his mother is becoming while holding onto who she once was.

Explore a haunting world built with a handcrafted stop-motion aesthetic. Solve puzzles, wander the countryside, and uncover the tragic mystery behind your family’s curse. More than a fight for survival, this is an unsettling tale about the fragile bonds of family and the quiet horrors of war.

Adventure, Exploration & Puzzles

Solve environmental puzzles, interact with the environment with platformer mechanics, and explore the interconnected countryside using your bicycle to reach new locations between your quests.

Resources & Crafting

Tend your garden, gather vegetables and herbs, and craft essential items needed to endure the adventure and progress through the story. Find and craft specific recipes to elaborate potions, healing soups and food dishes to keep your mother, and yourself, alive.

A haunting Stop-motion world of Wonder and Nightmares

Journey through a handcrafted stop-motion world where every tactile, eerie scene mirrors an emotionally intense story of childhood grief, trauma, and fractured family bonds. The flavour of horror we are tapping into leans more to psychological tension and memorable emotional impact rather than traditional horror.

An original haunting soundtrack

A fully original, eerie score that deepens the immersion and emotion throughout your journey till the bitter end.

2301340.name: Pato Martinez
2301340.about_the_game:
Pato Martinez is a Shoot’em Up videogame set during the Spanish Civil War, thought as a learning tool and to make the history more entertaining.
We propose a trip though the most important air battles of the war: El paso del estrecho, la ofensiva de Madrid, la batalla del Jarama, etc.

Educational material
When you begin each game, the player can watch a cinematic about the evolution of the war, the men that fought and the planes they controlled.



Inside the game you can access information about all the forces that fought, planes description, the list of all the aces that fought, etc.



All the educational material was reviewed by aviation history experts so that it has historical accuracy.

Game
After the cinematics you’ll be able to flight with planes like Polikarpov I-16 “Mosca” or the Fiat CR-32 “Chirri”. All the planes that appear on the games are real representations of aircrafts that fought during the war.

The backgrounds of each game reflect the environmental conditions on those fights and the other vehicles that fought there like the T-26 or the CV-33.

Special features
We’ve added a special emphasis on both the music and the graphic style so that the can represent the atmosphere of the war, using music, typos and graphic designs used at that time.

Text-based fun for your imagination!

Uncover the secrets of a mysterious dungeon in this text-based adventure, where every adventure is different! Establish a base camp, venture forth into the dungeon, and get ready for the many puzzles, monsters, and other strange denizens that await! Tackle each encounter in your own way, with each situation having multiple ways to progress.

A different adventure with each playthrough

With over a hundred unique encounters, no two playthroughs will be the same. To add even more variety, the residents of the dungeon will react to how you have handled previous encounters, allowing you to discover different secrets based on how you play! 2301480.name: Cuckoo Mask

Cuckoo Mask is a thrilling and engaging visual novel game that explores the dynamics of relationships, fetish, and cheating. The game follows the story of a main character who gets bullied in a... fun and sexy way! Making it perfect for masochistic players or those who enjoy reading about humiliation.

The game begins with the main character missing the last train of the day and feeling lost, but he stumbles upon a masked party where he sees a girl who looks like his girlfriend. Everyone at the party wears a mask, and the owner of the house is nowhere to be seen. The main character soon discovers that no one he meets is inclined to treat him well, but... he finds himself enjoying the mistreatment.

As the game progresses, players can freely explore the house and talk to anyone, or examine the room. Time passes as the player progresses through a character's route, with dialogues changing every hour to create the feeling of a real party. To reach the climax of a character's route, players must find them in the crowd and talk to them, just like at a party.



LOTS OF ART
Cuckoo Mask is a visual novel game that focuses on the art of storytelling through appealing illustrations. The game features a lot of art from the talented artist Hassel_Nut, who has created an array of lewd, charming scenes throughout the game. Players will be able to experience the story through a naughty lens, as the art brings each scene to life in a unique, indecent way. Hassel Nut's art is a standout feature of the game, showcasing the artist's skill and love for lewdness. Whether you're a fan of visual novels or just appreciate erotic art, Cuckoo Mask is a game that is sure to impress.

ROSTER OF FUNNY AND HANDSOME CHARACTERS
The game features a number of different characters with their own sex scenes and kinks, allowing players to explore different aspects of the being dominated and, or, humiliated. Secondary characters also play an important role in the game, as they contribute to the flow of the story. Each character has their own unique personality, they also love to bully you and steal your girlfriends. So if you enjoy that, or if you enjoy a large character roster handling a situation out of the norm, make sure to check it out.

NO SEX?
The game features this little and perky aspect wher the main character will NOT have any sexual encounter, even though other characters do. This adds an interesting layer to the story, as players will experience the meaning of being a loser. This allows players to focus more on the voyeur aspect of the game, and how even the characters that are attracted to you will not even youch you. 2301500.name: Paper Planes
2301500.about_the_game:
Welcome to the exhilarating world of Paper Planes, Prepare to embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey where strategy, skill, and precision are the keys to victory. In this fast-paced game, you'll engage in epic dogfights, outmaneuver rivals, and strategically dismantle their bases to claim dominance in the skies.

Gameplay Overview:

Play solo or with friends. Whether you're taking down an onslaught of unique objectives by yourself, facing intimidating bosses, or battle against your friends, there's something for everyone of all ages to enjoy. Paper Planes pits players against each other in intense aerial combat, where the primary objective is to eliminate opposing players' bases while defending your own. You'll navigate through diverse landscapes, ranging from lush forests to treacherous canyons, each offering unique challenges and tactical opportunities.

Key Features:

Customizable nostalgic toy planes:

Choose from an array of meticulously designed paper, foam, and toy planes, each with its own customizable features.

Dynamic Combat Mechanics:

Experience dynamic aerial combat with responsive controls and physics-based gameplay. Master the art of aerial maneuvers, including barrel rolls, loop-the-loops, and evasive maneuvers, to outmaneuver opponents and evade incoming fire.

Team-based Strategy:

Form alliances and coordinate with teammates to launch coordinated assaults on enemy bases or defend against incoming threats. Communication and teamwork are crucial for achieving victory in intense PVP, team, and free-for-all battles.

Progression and Rewards:

Earn experience points and unlock new planes, weapons, and upgrades as you progress through the ranks. Compete in ranked matches to climb the leaderboard and earn exclusive rewards, including rare customization options and in-game currency.

Immersive Environments:

Immerse yourself in stunning, handcrafted environments. From bustling metropolises to city parks to psychadelic mushroom worlds, every location is brimming with detail and personality.

Social Integration:

Connect with friends, join guilds, and participate in events to enhance your gaming experience. Share replays of your most epic battles, strategize with teammates, and compete in tournaments to prove your skills as the ultimate ace pilot.

Conclusion:

Prepare to take flight in the ultimate test of skill, strategy, and aerial supremacy. Whether you're soaring through the clouds or engaging in intense dogfights, Paper Planes offers an unmatched adrenaline rush and endless hours of thrilling action. So, assemble your squadron, customize your plane, and dominate the skies in this high-flying adventure!

2301540.name: Hunting Bigfoot
2301540.about_the_game:
After a military transport got struck by Bigfoot You were left as the only survivor. Now it's up to You to hunt down Bigfoot and put an end on the rogue creature.

Equipment

Equipment is the key to your success. Your gear consists of anything from medkits to flares and weapons. Use different weapon types and setup explosives to gain the advantage during an encounter with Bigfoot. Use your trustworthy gps to locate points of interests along with tracking bigfoot.

Maps

Visit multiple locations, and explore beautiful landscapes. Be on the lookout for points of interest to find loot, unlock new objectives and respawn points along with hidden secrets.

Objectives

Your main goal is to hunt down Bigfoot but through all the carnage there is still important tasks to complete alongside the hunt. Side objectives can vary from locating fallen soldiers to collecting samples from the local wildlife for research purpose. New objectives can be found by exploring the map and locating various points of interests.

2301560.name: Tempus Rail
2301560.about_the_game:
Trapped forever on a train to nowhere. Once seen as the greatest invention of the 1800's, the Tempus Rail was a vast locomotive that breached the temporal rift and gifted it's passengers eternal life. Free from consequence and even death, the passengers aboard the Tempus Rail travelled the temporal streams at the precise speed to reset time each day. But when the maiden voyage ended and it was time to leave the temporal rift, the train never stopped. Now countless cycles beyond, the train has devolved into chaos with few who have held their sanity.

As one of these lucky (or unlucky) few who find themselves barricaded in the rear of the train, you must fight your way to the front of the train in the hopes of stopping the train before days end.

Deck-Builder

Fight your way through deadly carriages using a turn-based combat system in which your deck holds the key to your survival. Collect rare and powerful cards on your journey from fallen enemies, or through optional story missions and quests. Start each run with a different deck as you unlock and discover more abilities tied to the mysterious crystal shards that grow on the outside of the train.

Death Is Not The End

Cursed with eternal life, each death is just an opportunity for progression as you awake in your bed again each morning. Do not expect the encounters to be the same each day as factions beyond the barricade fight for control in a never ending conflict.

A Wild West Unlike Our Own

Fight your way through a world scarred with the technological advancements unseen in our own history books. Encounter machines awakening to their own existence and those who seek modifications to themselves that would be deemed most unholy.

2301570.name: The Lost Hotel
2301570.about_the_game:
... to The Lost Hotel, a story-based pixel art game where you take on the role of a hotelier, tasked with saving the hotel from an endless time loop. Explore the hotel and interact with a diverse cast of characters, each with their own unique personalities and stories. Uncover secrets and solve puzzles as you work to unravel the mystery of the hotel's past.





Become the new hotelier by personalising your avatar, getting your special key and learning how to make every day a perfect day for your guests and staff!



From cooking and crafting, to managing and fixing electronics, you'll need to master a variety of skills to keep your guests happy and your hotel running smoothly.



As you explore the hotel, you'll discover that time is not on your side. The hotel is stuck in a time loop, and you'll have to unravel the truth behind the hotel's journey and its mysterious past by using your time wisely!



With a mix of exploration, puzzle-solving, management, and social interaction, The Lost Hotel offers an immersive and engaging gameplay experience with a touch of nostalgia from the pixel art graphics. Whether you're chatting with the eccentric hotel guests or uncovering hidden clues, there's always something new to discover in The Lost Hotel. Join us on this thrilling journey through space, as you work to not only keep the hotel running, but also uncover the secrets of the mysterious time loop.



Whether you master all the skills as quickly as possible in order to free the hotel and its guests - or whether you sit relaxed at the hotel bar and have a new conversation with the NPCs every time the time loop restarts - that's up to you!

2301580.name: Cyphen
2301580.about_the_game:
Zero gravity social combat simulator: Guns, Spaceships and Explosions.

Play with your friends and meet new ones in massive online dedicated servers. The Cyphen project has many zero-gravity activities for your engagement. Maneuver a spaceship throughout the vast polygon world, dodging plasma bullets in the pursuit of victory.

Voice chat is on by default! Leisure with friends in the social lounge and join a battle just by sitting down at any battle table.

The Cyphen experiment will become whatever the community makes of it. Space explorer.

2301590.name: Magic and Legend - Time Knights
2301590.about_the_game:
Story

Magic & Legend are two kids who were playing in the park with their friends when suddenly... Aliens came down to earth, to take over the planet and drain its natural resources. To make it easier and avoid any technologies that humankind could use against them, they open a time portal and go into the past to take over the human race.

Magic & Legend will not stand for this! After telling their Mom, they follow the aliens from the time portal to rid the planet of the aliens and ultimately save the world!

Features

This platform action / adventure game harks back to the days of old, where the Gameboy ruled the world for handheld game play. The game features 5 large sprawling levels over the time periods:
  • Level 1: The Journey Begins… (Present Day)
  • Level 2: Medieval Times
  • Level 3: Sengoku Period
  • Level 4: Ancient Rome
  • Level 5: The Crown Jewel Heist (60’s London)

Players can switch between Magic or Legend at any point and use their different abilities to progress through the game:
  • Magic loves getting up close and person, so uses melee weapons and can stomp on their heads (Super Mario style). He is the older brother.
  • Legend prefers long distance attacks. He is younger and lighter than his brother, so can't stomp on alien noggins, but with his projectile weapon, he can take out the aliens from a far.

In each level you must kill all the aliens before stepping into the time portal for the next time period. Magic and Legend have their own costumes and weapons and along the way, you will see other portals to mini bonus levels. These levels are just for fun, where you get to be a dragon, squid, a buster of ghosts and a mole man with a mallet!

Lastly, to ensure the world is safe, the boys go up against a final boss who is hell bent on taking out Magic & Legend.

Will you take up the challenge and save the planet for all humankind?

What's included:

Originally released for the Gameboy Color, Magic & Legend: Time Knights is now coming to Steam, available for Windows, MacOS & Linux. The game includes the rom, packaged with the emulator to be able to play natively on your PC without any configuration or setup required.

The Gameboy, Gameboy Color & Analogue Pocket roms are also included in the package to play on any device of your choosing, including:
  • Gameboy, Gameboy Color, Gameboy Advance (in Gameboy mode) via an Everdrive Cartridge.
  • Analogue Pocket
  • MiSTer FPGA using the Gameboy / Gameboy Color cores
  • Any other emulation device capable of playing Gameboy roms with accurate emulation.

2301600.name: TouhouTraveler
2301600.about_the_game:
You can move with the arrow keys on your keyboard, and you can upgrade the player's abilities by pressing the "Esc" button.
You can interact with NPCs, treasure chests, etc. with the space bar, and press the Z key to attack.
Depending on the attack power, there are a total of 4 stages of attack.

The game is cleared by upgrading the player by catching treasure chests and monsters that are continuously created, and by catching the final boss.

Move freely and find treasure chests.
Treasure chests are hidden all over the map.

Along with simple quests, NPCs will tell you how to play and in which direction to play.

Upgrade your players with coins obtained by finding treasure chests or defeating enemies.
The player's attack is upgraded according to the attack power.

Items you get can be converted into coins through NPCs.

There are simple labyrinths and areas blocked by invisible walls on the map, which can be solved through interaction.

2301630.name: Goblins
2301630.about_the_game:
Command the Emerald Goblin Army, avenge and defeat the Ruby Goblin Army and win the Great Gold War.



Recruit special classes such as: Mages, Bombers, Barbarians, Necromancers and more. Call for precise artillery strikes to cause maximum destruction. Master Battles through 20 unique and increasingly difficult Campaign maps. Challenge yourself further in Freeplay Battles by selecting the highest difficulty.


Enjoy a break from Battles and play a casual Mini-Game. Steal as much gold as possible from the enemy in Ruby Robbery, on your quest to steal a precious gem from the enemy. Face off against the entire "Knights Gauntlet" at once in a fierce battle. And more to come in the future.


-Multiplayer Open BETA Available Now-

2301640.name: Misteri Rumah Pak RT
2301640.about_the_game:
"Misteri Rumah Pak RT" is a horror-themed action-puzzle multiplayer game set in a mysterious mansion house owned by Pak RT. Players must explore the dark and eerie corridors, solve challenging puzzles, and uncover the secrets of the mansion to find the keys that will unlock the exit and allow them to escape.

In this game, players must use their problem-solving skills and quick reflexes to navigate the dangers of the mansion, as they face a variety of obstacles and challenges that threaten to prevent their escape. The game can be played with up to 4 players in co-op mode, allowing players to team up and work together, or as a single player experience, where players will face the computer-controlled antagonist.

The computer-controlled antagonist adds a unique and challenging twist to the game, as the AI is programmed to be highly intelligent and adaptable to the player's actions. The computer will actively try to prevent players from escaping, making the game even more challenging.

With a spooky and immersive atmosphere, challenging puzzles, and intense action, "Misteri Rumah Pak RT" offers an unforgettable gaming experience for players looking for a horror-themed action-puzzle multiplayer game. Whether playing alone or with friends, players will be transported to a world of mystery and terror as they try to solve the mystery of Pak RT's mansion.

The game is available now on Steam, so gather your friends and embark on an adventure to escape the mysterious mansion of Pak RT.

2301670.name: AI Solitaire
2301670.about_the_game:
AI Solitaire features both Klondike Solitaire and Pyramid Solitaire. It includes 18 different deck styles to choose from and has password protected parental controls to make sure that you and your family only see the content you choose to see. 2301690.name: Vagrant Knight
2301690.about_the_game:
Vagrant Knight is a top-down challenging action roguelike
with hack-n-slash combat mechanics paired with spell casting.
Clear each room of never-ending horde of monsters.



At end of each level,
upgrade your character melee attack or equip yourself with new spell.
Discover how each combination of these melee weapon enchantment
and spell slinging take out incoming enemies.


  • Choose from 32 unique spells to cast onto enemies.
  • Enhance your melee attacks with any of 22 special attacks.
  • Boost your stats with 18 unique traits.

Play in 9 different levels.

Fight against 20 unique enemies.

  • Hack and slash your way against room filled with waves and waves of enemies.
  • Use newly acquired spells and special attacks to repel wave of incoming enemies.
  • Many upgradable stats to build up your character.

2301750.name: Peasant Kingdom
2301750.about_the_game:
Description:

Peasant Kingdom is a medieval PVP game where players can build castles, craft items, fight other players with a wide variety of historical weapons, besiege and defend castles.

Ranged combat:



Take part in exciting battles with a wide variety of throwing weapons. Each of these weapons has its own unique characteristics and involves a specific playstyle.


Melee combat:



Melee combat is represented by full control over the direction of the weapon's strike and the position of the shield. To block an enemy strike, you need to cover exactly the area in which the strike is directed.


Building:



Design your castles in such a way that it is more difficult for other players to besiege them. The possibilities of the game offer a lot of scope for various tricky castle designs.


Placeables:



Build structures that will help you craft items, cook food, process resources and much more.

Contact email: lucky18.inc@gmail.com

2301770.name: Ven'rif
2301770.about_the_game:
A CASUAL REAL-TIME STRATEGY GAME Summon unique creatures, cast explosive spells, survive the assassination! Ven'rif is a casual real-time strategy card game where you build a deck of collectible cards and fight against another player on the battlefield. Ven'rif simplifies what other real-time strategy games can't all the while retaining the depth of the gameplay at a cheap expense of a shorter playtime.

Objectives:

  • Kill the opposing avatar (Winning),

  • Destroy as much totems before the timer runs out (Winning),

  • Gather the right resources to use your cards,

  • Do side quests to get more resources,

Features:

  • With over 80 cards to build around your deck,

  • Multiplayer 1v1,

  • Casual controls (use cards, trade resources, enchantcards)

2301830.name: SOLD OUT
2301830.about_the_game:
In the game "SOLD OUT", you are the owner of a small grocery store with limited start-up capital. You have to use your wisdom to buy goods, stock them up, and then use market volatility to buy low and sell high to earn the maximum profit. And face the evil landlord who came to collect the rent within the agreed time.

"SOLD OUT" is an idle management game, you need to satisfy the customers who come to shop as much as possible. Earn wealth to buy more and better goods.

Business Intelligence

In this game, you need to have sufficient business thinking, fully consider market changes, and draw information and experience from market changes. Think about when to buy, when to sell, when to stockpile, etc.

Placing skills

In this game, it is important to judge market changes, but only by successfully selling products can you truly earn wealth. Only by considering the customer's occupancy, considering the customer's likes and dislikes, and using the customer and product occupancy to maximize the benefits as much as possible, can it be possible to calmly face the rent-collecting landlord. Well, you know the consequences of not being able to pay the rent.

2301850.name: Story of Animal Sprite
2301850.about_the_game:
New Update: Season Festival!

New items only for each sensons!

Seasonal limited animals as well!





Legend has it that in a picturesque beachside wonderland is an age-old Spirit Tree that has been blessing this place since the dawn of time and attracted animals to dwell around it.

One day, a volcano erupted, laying to waste many parts of the land. The inhabitants take actions, deciding to restore the environment and revive their homeland with the help of Purifying Light.

Merging Brings Happiness and Cures OCD

Create a new home and everything is about merging objects to upgrade. Various items are for you to merge. Collecting and organizing will never end.

Manage Resources with Efficient Recycling Loops

A variety of plants and resource-producing structures require constant merging and planning on the go. Make sure that production and building are in tandem with each other to develop the homeland.

Cute Animals Help You

Merging animal balls summons helpers like kittens, bearlings and monkeys to collect stuff for you. Merging animals unlcoks new styles for them to busy themselves in the forest with cuter styles.

Develop a Land of Your Own

A great piece of land can be unlocked part by part as you progress in the game. Merge an assortment of items and structures to develop a land of your own.

Endless Unlockables

Tons of animals, plants and structures for you to unlock and fill the Encyclopedia.

2301880.name: Conflux
2301880.about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in a unique fantasy world as you explore and interact with a wide variety of colourful characters. Engage in strategic turn-based battles alongside your trusted allies. Uncover the story as it unfurls across the diverse realms of this spellbinding role-playing game.

  • Unlock new members for your party as you progress.

  • Acquire a wide selection of new skills and magical items to aid you on your journey.

2301900.name: Lost with you
2301900.about_the_game:
About this game


Survive with her!

You've been through an unfortunate plane crash.
Luckily, you survived, but ended up being stranded on a deserted island.
But there is still hope. 'Cause you're not alone
Can you survive and escape from the deserted island with her?

Survival




You have to manage your health, stamina, hunger and thirst. When your health reaches 0, it's game over.

Choice




You will be given options during the conversation. One choice won't bring a big change, but your reputation will gradually change.

Mini game


Your survival skills will be tested. Several mini-games are prepared, and the more you become proficient, the better you will survive.

2301920.name: Mimics the bots
2301920.about_the_game:
What is Mimics the bots ?

Mimics the bots is a fun little game to be played with friends. One player embodies a killer and the other the finder. The problem is that the killer has the same body as the villager. The killer will need to stealthily kill 4 bots to win the game within 10 minutes. The finder will only have 3 attempts to flush out the killer.
To your bluffs!

2301940.name: BLOW-UP: AVENGE HUMANITY
2301940.about_the_game:
BLOW-UP is a single-player first person movement shooter campaign inspired by the best shooters around the Y2K era, reimagining classic action with frantic and dynamic gameplay, along with a modern take on retro graphics and a visually striking “colorful gore” aesthetic.

Your objective is to beat the 20 stages the game has to offer as fast as possible, each one will introduce new tools that will aid your quest of vengeance, but also new challenges to overcome.

Put yourself in the circuit board of the M098 Barbara, a 3 meter tall industrial robot rewired by Ann, the last human alive, to avenge humanity from the alien race that has destroyed Earth. Use any means necessary to violently deny the military occupation the aliens have established on Earth’s debris.

Featuring:

  • 6 weapons, each one with an alternate fire mode

  • Brutal melee combat

  • Movement mechanics that are also lethal for enemies

  • 20 stage replayable campaign

  • Secrets

  • 4 bosses.

  • Infinite wave mode

  • 2D cutscenes

2301960.name: Cube Roller
2301960.about_the_game:
A casual racing game of rolling a ball through various cube mazes of increasing complexity!
Compete for the fastest time to earn your spot on the global leaderboards!
Redefining everything humanity thought mazes could be!
If you have an underdeveloped sense of spatial awareness, this might not be the game for you!

2301970.name: Bubble Sweeper
2301970.about_the_game:
Bubble Sweeper is a fresh take on the classic game of MineSweeper. In addition to the traditional square playfield, Bubble Sweeper offers a variety of shapes and sizes to keep the game interesting. The clean graphics and satisfying sounds of popping bubbles make for an enjoyable experience. And if you accidentally hit a mine, the game is not over yet! You'll have a chance to finish the game before the timer runs out. Challenge yourself with the different playfield layouts, sizes, and difficulty levels! The perfect game for short play sessions!

  • Choose from different field layouts, shapes, and difficulty settings.
  • Enjoy updated, polished graphics and that satisfying sound of popping bubbles.
  • Second chance to finish the game before timer runs out

2301990.name: Rally31
2301990.about_the_game:
Rally31 is a small open-world racing game with 12 unique and experimental vehicles. The vehicles are physics-based with each one having a different setup to the suspension system. This adds variety to the difficulty level and driving experience of each machine.

The vehicles use a cell shader inspired by the anime Wangan Midnight and the rest of the environment is done in a cartoon style.

The level is a chain of islands that are built on a base that is 6 km long and 3 km wide. Each island is fully explorable.

You can buy more cars and access your inventory at the player’s house. You can earn money to buy cars by finishing stages. You can get a reward bonus by beating your best time or for completing a stage with a car that is difficult to drive.

All the controls are listed in the pause menu that is accessed with the escape key.

You can open and close the map with the “M” key. The map marks the start of stages with red flags and the player’s house with a blue house icon.

If you get stuck, you can rewind by holding “X” on the keyboard or ”Y” on a controller. If you cannot free yourself with the rewind, then press “R” on the keyboard to reset your position back to the start of the level.

The controller can be turned on in the options menu accessed via the pause menu, by clicking “CLICK TO USE A CONTROLLER”.

The options menu also allows you to adjust the volume and change the gearbox behaviour from automatic to manual.

I plan on supporting and updating this game for the foreseeable future.

2302000.name: ClownScapades Rally
2302000.about_the_game:
You met him from your birthday party, as one of your family members had hired him to entertain the crowd, however things go dark as you start to have nightmares about him and you end up in strange, unfamiliar places within them...

ClownScapades Rally is a stylized survival horror game which revolves around a protagonist who begins experiencing nightmares after encountering a clown named Clownie at a birthday party. In one of these dreams, the player wakes up in a sewer and embarks on a journey to explore its depths.
Unbeknownst to the player, they are reliving the past reality of a lost soul who once wandered into a similar scenario and met a tragic end. As the player navigates through the eerie environments, their objective is to release the trapped souls that reside within the depths of these nightmares.

ClownScapades Rally offers multiple game modes to keep players engaged. In Survival mode, players must endure random events and survive for a set amount of time. Escape mode challenges them to find an escape route by solving puzzles and overcoming obstacles. And Collect mode requires players to locate and gather various objectives scattered throughout the levels, delving deeper into the secrets of the game.

Throughout the game, players will encounter a cast of intriguing characters such as Clownie, Smoky, Berry, Jacky, and more! Each character holds their own enigmatic presence and their creations are even more mysterious.

Prepare yourself as you unveil the secrets of this game, and navigate through the atmospheric world of ClownScapades Rally.

2302020.name: Shadows of the Night
2302020.about_the_game:
PRESENTATION


This is a 2D old-school RPG in the vein of Fantasy Heroes and Skyfall.

A thousand years ago, the country was divided between two kinds, those who were willing to follow principles of truth and justice and those who were not. The latter, were expelled to what is known as the "Outer Lands", beyond the walls of the Night Fortress. The Night Soldiers are the ones entrusted with the duty of keeping the Outers away, being the constant threat that they are, Pallas has his hands full. Having joined the Fortress out of his sense of duty towards protecting his country and most importantly to him, his family, he will soon realize that to truly protect them he will have to abandon it all.
There is a war coming.

FEATURES


  • Inspiring storytline of heroism, family, friendship and sacrifice
  • A dynamic party system, experience the story from different perspectives spawning between eight playable characters
  • Sidequests, optional dungeons and bosses to discover
  • Exciting battle system with over 60 skills to use and dozens of equipments and accessories to choose from
  • A fully orchestrated storyline that gives life and rythm to the story
  • Three different dificulty levels to play on
  • The world of Shadows of the Night is vast and varied. You will travel through villages, cities, forests, caves, castles, deserts and snowy locations
  • 15 to 20 hours of gameplay

2302030.name: The Dragon Queen
2302030.about_the_game:
PRESENTATION


This is a 2D old-school RPG in the vein of Last Heroes and Midnight's Blessing.

Enola has lived her own life on a small village secluded from the rest of the world. With an adventurous spirit, she tries her best to find trouble in an otherwise uneventful life. Unaware of her own history, she is curious about others and their stories. The answers she looks for are to be found in the way she always dreamed of, exploring all four corners of the world. What she never expected was the truths those answers would bring forth.

FEATURES


  • A vast world to explore, spawning into forests, deserts, caves, mountains, snowy locations and more
  • A classical storyline that pays homage to the great classics of the genre
  • Sidequests to complete
  • A dragon to fly
  • Up to 15 to 20 hours of gameplay
  • Mouse support
  • Quest journal to track your objectives

2302040.name: The Great Divide
2302040.about_the_game:
PRESENTATION


This is a 2D old-school RPG in the vein of Last Heroes and Skyfall.

The One Being, the Goddess who ruled it all, one day grew tormented by the actions of its own creations. That frustration led to what is known as The Great Divide. The One Being was split in two, a Spirit of Good and a Spirit of Evil. The world faces unbalance as those spirits fight each other for full control.
Yas and Ursula are two best friends who lived their whole lives in Buccan Village, an idyllic place far away from all the troubles of the world, it's as if it exists in its own reality. That all changes when a stranger shows up at their shores...

FEATURES


  • Classic good and evil storyline, reminiscent of the great classics and mythologies
  • Journey through forests, caves, mountains, valleys and shrines
  • Up to 10 hours of exciting gameplay
  • Sidequests and optional dungeons to complete
  • Quest Journal to keep track of your missions
  • Mouse Support

2302050.name: First Light
2302050.about_the_game:
PRESENTATION


This is a 2D old-school RPG in the vein of Black Home and A Plunge into Darkness.

After a devastating Plague purged most of humanity, the few who survived escaped to the underground, in an attempt to survive the disease. After a decade of living in the dark, away from the world. Bahar, and his wife Guidry, believe the Plague has ceased to be and are on the pursuit of a way out, a way back to the world they once knew.

The path is long and perilous, but they will walk it bravely so their children, Dan and Ava, can finally start living instead of just surviving.

FEATURES


A touching storyline that will resonate with all of us given the latest circumstances
An adventurous pace that will keep you on your toes
Explore the underground world, a place full of mystery and dangers
Auto-save feature to keep you from meaningless repetition

2302080.name: Death of a Wish
2302080.about_the_game:
Death of a Wish is a vicious action-RPG where style is salvation.

Play as Christian as he unites with new comrades to challenge the order that raised him. By taking down the four Sanctum Faiths: Father, Sister, Cardinal, and Priest, they will upend the order of the world.

Fight your way through a nightmare filled with horrifying monsters and terrifying people. Master brutal attacks and flashy combos as you struggle against the Corruption consuming you with style and grace. Shine your light in this surreal sea of darkness.

ENGAGE IN VICIOUSLY GRACEFUL COMBAT

Unleash Christian’s cursed powers in a demanding and rewarding combat system. Be careful not to succumb to the ever-encroaching Corruption; achieve high ranks in combat and perform graceful combos to hold the Corruption at bay.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR MARKED POWERS

Rend your foes asunder with magical combos called Arias. Enhance your abilities with powerful Virtues that alter your approach to battle and the rhythm of combat. With a limitless array of ways to fight stylishly, build your character with passion to destroy your foes.

DESCEND INTO THE NIGHTMARE

In the dreamworld of Paradiso, repressed memories and unspeakable feelings come to life as the nightmarish city of Neo-Sanctum. Delve into the secret underworld of the esoteric and abandoned to meet new comrades who will aid you on your journey.

SURREAL AND SPECTACULAR

Christian’s world is rendered with a surreal aesthetic like no other. Harsh, pulsating scratches upon a sea of darkness render a thick atmosphere brooding with emotion. Battles come to life in an animated spectacle of light and motion that remains easy to parse in play.

For audio, Nicolo Telesca’s chilling score mixes electronic sounds with live instrumentation and complements the visuals by eliciting feelings of tense anxiety and electrifying catharsis.

Game contains imagery that may be harmful to players with photosensitive epilepsy or similar conditions. See content warnings below.

2302120.name: Infinitum: The Backrooms Story
2302120.about_the_game:
Infinitum features an unique story with multiple endings, where every choice you make matters. Set in a reimagined backrooms universe, it delivers a fresh, terrifying horror experience. This isn’t just another game where you "wake up in the backrooms" and try to escape. Your decisions determine what your outcome is within the game.

The open-world, non-linear gameplay offers multiple ways to travel between levels, allowing you to choose how you want to play INFINITUM. You can admire the beauty of Level 37 or get lost in the infinite mall of Level 33—if that's what you desire. Just be sure to listen closely, because you never know who or what might be lurking around the corner.

Infinitum has many gameplay mechanics and features that aid the experience of the player.

The multiplayer voting system ensures players work together on decisions like traveling to specific levels or starting quests. Every player must vote "yes" or "no" to move forward, and collective agreement is required. Be mindful, you only have a few seconds to decide, or your vote will be automatically declined.

The bunker is your personal safehouse and the only place where your progress is saved. Inside, you can store, craft, and build items to assist you on your journey. You can also name your bunker and customize the light colors to make it feel even more personal and likable.

To reach the outpost, you must travel through a tunnel from your bunker. Once there, you can interact with NPCs, complete quests, and make crucial decisions to advance the story.

Infinitum is built on a tile-based generation system that creates fresh experiences each time you enter a level. Every level features pre-built rooms with randomized properties like walls, , items, and entities. These rooms appear randomly and infinitely. This unpredictability is the essence of Infinitum, guaranteeing that every playthrough feels like a new adventure.

To survive in the game, you must eat and drink to maintain your stamina. If your stamina runs out, your character won’t be able to sprint, making it much harder to escape if an entity starts chasing you.

Character customization plays a big role in the game. By completing quests and achievements, you'll be able to purchase various hazmat suit colors and models, badges, and other accessories to personalize your character.

Whether you want to play without jumpscares, tackle the game normally, go hardcore or explore without entities, Infinitum offers it all through various game modes, custom worlds, and in-depth settings.

If that didn’t already convince you, you can also adopt fat cats that will stay in your bunker forever. (That was our golden ticket!)

Infinitum is built using the latest Unreal Engine 5 technologies, delivering impressive graphics. However, we understand not everyone has a high-end computer, so we’ve introduced a Performance Mode. This option lowers the graphics quality, allowing players with lower-end PCs to enjoy the game smoothly.

2302160.name: Stacks:Space!
2302160.about_the_game:
Stacks:Space is a space-themed base builder card game with rogue-like elements. Buy booster packs to get new cards, discover craft recipes by stacking cards together, create structures, manufacture drones and droids, defend your base from enemies, visit distant planets, and more!

DISCLAIMER: This game is inspired by Stacklands, but it is not Stacklands, and it is not a sequel to Stacklands - it is a completely independent project that feels and plays differently from Stacklands.

Options and Features


  • Created with Stacks:Engine, a card game framework that is heavily inspired by the Stacklands and Cultist Simulator games
  • ~370 cards to collect and use in Stacks:Space (~370 cards in Stacks:Village mod)
  • ~100 craft recipes (some cards could be crafted via multiple recipes)
  • 7 unique bosses to defeat
  • 1 base location + 12 visitable quest locations (incl. shops)
  • Astronauts / Settlers have trainable attributes: Strength, Agility, Endurance, Intelligence
  • Various scenarios - each having different starting conditions, different end-game goals, or even a different location
  • Game Tutorial included for the first scenario
  • Daily Challenge Mode - an option to have a relatively quick game run with random goals and restrictions each day
  • Modding support

Combat


Both ranged and melee combat modes are supported (no combat box!). Melee units will move toward the enemy as soon as they see it. Drag your card next to an enemy card (do not stack them!), and you'll see them punching each other. Ranged units will shoot their projectiles immediately.
  • Stacked cards - the ones doing crafts - do not engage in combat, but could be attacked by an enemy card.
  • Some enemies prefer to attack resource cards instead.

Modding support


Stacks:Space is moddable! The built-in mod management interface allows near-infinite extension of a game. With just a tiny bit of JSON knowledge, it is possible to create and add new cards, recipes, scenarios, locations, and even completely new games. This game is so moddable that it already includes Stacks:Village, a fantasy village sim, as a mod - accessible via the top-right corner of the starting screen. See this youtube video for gameplay details. The comprehensive modding manual is a work in progress, please stay tuned.

2302230.about_the_game:
THE SUMMARY

6 Months remain before the fate of the world is sealed and humanity as it's known ceases to exist.

Yunis Caelum leads the charge to save humanity followed closely by his ensemble of childhood friends, Estella Kisiel, Angie Alfaro and Rictor Fitzsimmons as they venture into Iolade, a world connected loosely to their own through a force unbeknownst to them. Follow this group of unlikely saviours as they traverse the many regions of this unfamiliar land, taking down each Antiborne that stands in their way to salvation. 

With hopes of gaining answers to June's unprecedented disappearance just a year prior, the unlikely group of Heroes make their way through Iolade, piecing together their larger roles in this prophecy as they aim to put an end to the Scion of Time's terror and allow both Iolade and Terrus to live in peace.

FATE CHANGES FOR NO ONE.

GAMEPLAY & CONTENT:

  • 13 Unique Playable Characters

  • 3 Main Endings

  • 6 Acts of gameplay, each spanning roughly 4 or so hours

  • Full voice acting for story cutscenes and battle encounters

  • 9 unique regions of land to explore as you journey throughout the two worlds of Within Time

  • Unique Turn-based combat making use of the STANCE system, exclusive to Within Time

  • Over 100 achievements to obtain in your journey across Iolade and Terrus

  • Over 200 tracks composed by Oxiqa

THE TEAM

TEAM INNERMINDS is a small indie studio responsible for the development of WITHIN TIME, lead by developer LUNAVIA.

With a project overseen by programmer, pixel artist and lead writer Lunavia, Within Time features extensive combat mechanics, unique gameplay aspects across the board and various styles of gameplay for players to enjoy throughout the game's 50 hour runtime.

With all music lead, composed and recorded by talented musician Oxiqa the game features a lengthy OST that's certain resonate with players and fans alike! Using his experience on smaller projects in his past, Oxiqa brings an unheard talent to the table.

Featuring character art and designs from the very talented Yotsori, Lunavia's many character concepts are brought to life by the stellar character artist of TEAM INNERMINDS. Having experience working on various other game projects and creating character designs for just short of half a decade, Yotsori's talents shine through when visualising the characters of Within Time.

Illustrations and additional media designed by the incredibly talented Fluffmilk, a developer in her own regards, lends her years of artistic experience to create unforgettable art for the promotion and distribution of Within Time media.

Featuring Bakker as an additional Pixel Artist alongside Lunavia, his almost eight years in the field lend well to the project of Within Time as he creates unforgettable art, designs and set pieces that are sure to stick with the players.

Additional writing and combat design also provided by Luke and Mango as they both lend their extensive knowledge of JRPGs and TBRPGs to the Within Time team to create an unforgettable combat experience that'll keep players hooked for hundreds of hours!

Captivating story

Immerse yourself in amazing story about love, pain and sorrow, and decisions that can change your life. Unlock new fragments of the story, discover secrets and stop Teot tribe from ruling. Each tribe represents different world.

From temples, to caves and swamps. Although the general objective of the protagonist is established from the beginning, you will discover unique mechanics in each one of the Tribes that allows you exploring in different ways.

There is always something new to discover. As you progress, the scenarios will become more complex and large. Look for a hidden passages and secrets to reveal whole story.

2D Hand-Drawn

Each theme is designed to create unique atmosphere that captures essence of each tribe.

Step into the golden era of the arcade brawler. Kicked out of his own mob family, Rick is on a bloody quest for revenge across four grueling stages. This isn't just button-mashing; master a deep combat system featuring combos, clinches, parries, and counterattacks. Fill your super meter to unleash screen-clearing special moves as you fight through replicant ninjas, rabid dogs, and massive bosses.

Crescent Moon (Sci-Fi Shoot 'em Up)

A fast, frantic, horizontal bullet hell. The cosmic tyrant Trixion is invading, and you are the only defense. Memorize environmental traps, collect and swap between five distinct weapon types, and utilize support pods to survive. Built for high-score chasers: master the "No-Miss" multiplier system and dodge your way to the top of the leaderboards.

Heist of the Ninja (83' stealth arcade)

Experience classic single-screen arcade tension! Play as Koji the Ninja in an alternate-1983 heist. Navigate tightly guarded rooms, jump obstacles, and dig through furnishings for hidden loot. Use your shurikens wisely, outsmart the guards, and secure the treasure without triggering the alarm.

Peng Peng (Co-Op precision platformer)

Don't let the cute aesthetic fool you—Peng Peng is built for casuals, speedrunners, and hardcore score-catchers alike. Wipe out monsters across four worlds to rescue the kidnapped Frost Orb. Play solo or grab a friend in Local Co-Op. Will you rush to the end for a speed bonus, or meticulously clear enemies for maximum points? Hunt for secret rooms, special events, and uncover the hidden ending!

Step Into the Holua Universe...

Holua's Arcades is just the beginning. Meet Lyn, the vivacious gamer actually playing these arcade machines! Lyn is also the protagonist of our upcoming high-resolution metroidvania, FANTASY NETWORK.

Discover the meta-narrative linking these arcade classics to a much larger world. Play the hidden Demo level located just outside the virtual arcade room, and don't forget to wishlist Fantasy Network!

2303470.name: Wildwood: A Town Building Game
2303470.about_the_game:
Wildwood is a city building strategy game that is all about expansion. Start from nothing. As you gather resources and progress through the Tech Tree you will unlock new technologies that will help you survive. To reach more valuable resources you will need to expand. Deploy a logistics network of Trains and Wagons to connect your settlement together. As you continue to gather, build, expand, and connect you will be able to turn your surviving settlement into a thriving town.


Help your citizens thrive by building homes and workplaces for them. As you progress through the tech tree you will unlock new items and buildings that will help you in your quest to expand your settlement


The procedurally generated world of Wildwood is infinite. Explore new areas and take advantage of the resources available there. Expand your settlement as far as your heart desires and discover the endless possibilities of Wildwood.


Connect your settlement with a logistics network of trains and wagons. Move resources to where they are needed to ensure the survival of your settlement and to keep your citizens well provided for

Wildwood provides a unique challenge for players who want a survival city builder that allows you to endlessly expand your world. Start building your settlement today!

2303480.name: ZOM: Rise of the Apocalypse
2303480.about_the_game:
ZOM: Rise of the Apocalypse is a dynamic Trading and Collecting Card Game set in a post-apocalyptic world. With both strategic PvP multiplayer battles and an immersive RPG single player story, you'll be fully immersed in the universe of Zom.

Embark on a thrilling journey in the online universe of Zom. Choose your side and engage in strategic battles, using your wits and cunning to outwit your opponents.

Outside of battle, unleash your inner scientist and design custom abilities to dominate the battlefield with the simple yet powerful Ability Graph system. With the power of gene programming at your fingertips, you can create a deck that truly represents you and showcase your unique strategies. The Ability Graph system not only adds an extra layer of depth and customization to the gameplay, but also presents a thrilling opportunity for players to learn and apply concepts common in computer programming.

Join minds with other players to create powerful alliances, or go it alone and forge your own path to glory. The choice is yours.

2303500.name: MF-01 Aerostrike
2303500.about_the_game:
Alone in a far away planet. Surrounded by hostile pilots. The only way out is through sheer skill. Jump into the MF-01 Aerostrike and fight for survival. Fight to return to your family.

Big dogfights await you. Hundreds of enemy ships, of all kinds and sizes. You must make your way through a large underground complex. Find a way to escape the planet alive.

Along the way you may find useful equipment. Weapons for various roles and purposes. Modules to give you an edge in combat. Upgrades to enhance your capabilities.

Beware of experienced foes. Opponents that have made a name for themselves, flying unique vessels with their own set of powerful gear. Mercenaries, ace warriors, and leaders.

Now it is up to you. Fly into the great unknown, into the depths of steel and iron, and meet your fate.

2303530.name: Cowboys & Rustlers
2303530.about_the_game:
A man and a horse walk into a saloon…


Experience the story of two outlaw friends - an overly joyful rustler and a talking, cynical horse - told through the magic of a top-down action video game. Rob banks and roller-coasters summon ghosts at cemeteries, all while helping your horse friend in writing his revolutionary science-fiction novel.

Kinda Wild, Somewhat Weird West


That’s what the outsiders call it, interchangeably with Kinda Wild, Boy Do They Smell There West. It’s full of cowboys, skater(cow)boys, dusty towns, and photovoltaics. Everyone is weirdly enamored with spitting into spittoons and their favorite soup is whisky. Yet there’s also beauty. Some have honest work and don’t overwater their cactuses. There are even people with hobbies besides not starving to death.

Universal tools of communication


In a place as kinda wild and somewhat weird, it’s good to know how to communicate. Revolvers usually make the most convincing argument, especially with the help of swift fingers and good use of ricochet physics. A few lasso tricks and a Gatling gun will be irreplaceable in more complex discussions. It’s also worth remembering that nothing’s more powerful than friendship and a kick of a 1000-pound horse.

2303550.name: Zehlar
2303550.about_the_game:
Zehlar is an open world full of secrets and magic. Explore the different biomes, each with its own challenges and rewards, filled with creatures with unique abilities. The world is procedurally generated, so each player can experience a different world.

The creatures in the world have the ability to control different elements, allowing them to adapt to their environment. With their abilities, they can move through the area, protect themselves from threats, or even modify the terrain when necessary.

Humans do not have these powers, but they can acquire some of the creature's abilities through different methods, such as specialized technology. Although they will not be as strong as the powers of the creatures.

It is possible to ally with the creatures in the world. They can help you with many of the tasks and challenges that arise in the world. From building a base, protecting yourself from threats, accessing areas impossible for humans, caring for your crops, or simply helping with household tasks, you can always count on the help of allied creatures.



Both you and your captured creatures will need to train to become stronger and overcome the challenges that will arise in the world. And they can also learn increasingly specialized and more powerful abilities.

2303560.name: Best Pearl
2303560.about_the_game:
Best Pearl is a shooter where one of the sea inhabitants repels attacks, protecting the pearl he found. Be careful the steering wheel landing can hurt you. Don't let them get it. They must not reach her. You can handle it.

Features of the game:

- Music
- Simple operation
- Complexity

2303610.name: Fragrance Point
2303610.about_the_game:
We are speechless. After a hundred years of silence, research station Fragrance Point starts sending signals to earth. What does it mean? We are sending our most advanced security robot. Armed with lipstick, snazzy boots and a big heart, we are sure it will do the right thing. What will it find?

Fragrance Point is a digital paradise where you can do everything you want: Dress up, dance with aliens, and knock big things over. Make new friends, embarrass yourself in front of everyone, and you might just find a way into the station's core.

2303620.name: Turn on the lights carefully
2303620.about_the_game:
Turn on the lights carefully is a disassemble puzzle game that features a recursive mechanics in which the player has to explore micro pieces to connect a circuit and solve the main puzzle.

Key features


  • Minimalist design and colors
  • Relaxing soundtrack
  • Chill game
  • No time pressure
  • Steam achievements

2303630.name: Saint Warner's Angels
2303630.about_the_game:
Saint Warner's Angels is an action packed coming-of-age story of enormous proportions.
Experience the gripping epic of Mya Oakley in a retro-pixel world accompanied with cutscenes that are brought to life with hand-drawn illustrations and animations.



Welcome to 1985! Since you'll be living in Warner's Pass in the great Lone Star State, let's take a little tour. Would you like to admire the mayor’s house and marvel at how rich he is compared to the rest of the town? Or maybe visit the trailer park; if you are lucky enough you won’t get hit with a flung beer bottle as you pass by the Reagan ‘88 sign.

If you're strapped for cash, you can pick up odd jobs, diner shifts, or even requests on your local job board.

When you're not doing that, you will join in the fight against the growing threat of a Cryptid invasion though gorgeously hand drawn turn based battles. To pose a real threat, timing your attacks through action commands will surely give those monsters a run for their money.

Team up with up to 2 party members that make up Mya’s brother and her friends. And when the battles get rough and your energy surges, unleash your group’s fury through Special Attacks and Duo Special Attacks: animated assaults of multiple characters combining their strengths to leave their enemies devastated. Push back against the impossible odds along side the people who have always been by your side.

2303670.name: Escape From The Sun
2303670.about_the_game:
Dash through levels.
Escape the emerging suns.
Shoot everything in sight.

Escape from the Sun is a speedrun shooter all about avoiding our Suns! as they're very evil!!

Choose from over 30 weapons to shoot anything in sight. Your inventory can only hold 10 items so it will be wise to use the most effective weapons later in the game.

Each level is a chase sequence, where you run away from the emerging 4 suns in the solar system through over 20+ levels. Shooting knocks them back but it only makes them come back stronger.

Prepare to die alot with lots of challenging bosses to fight, each with their own gimmick.

2303720.name: Multiplayer Cowboys
2303720.about_the_game:
Multiplayer Cowboys

The Town is being taken over by Ghosts. Can You and Your Posse Survive ?

This is a Fast Paced RPG Survival game.

The game includes a Single & Multiplayer CO-OP system via Steam.

You can Invite Your Steamy Friends with the ' + ' Icon on the Main Menu and Team Up !

The Game is packed with a complete inventory management and crafting system, missions, building system, environmental harvesting, and looting system, swimming system, level-ups, and AI, combat mechanics, and many more features provided down below, tested online with clients under server-load. Compatible with Steam online subsystem.

* NOTE : You should have a Stable & Fast Internet Connection for Best Results *

2303730.name: Magnetik
2303730.about_the_game:
In this game you play as a robot who has the skill to generate an electric field that attracts or repulses a magnet presented in each level. The goal is to make the magnet reach its right target, sometimes there will be multiple magnets and here is where the puzzle gets more exciting.

Boxes, blocks, keys, potions, conveyor belts, holes, teleportation, levers and many more items combined make each level unique. It is up to you how to solve each puzzle, have fun!

Move around

Think

Try

Choose

Enjoy it

Challenge yourself and your friends, have fun!

2303740.name: Virtual Families 3
2303740.about_the_game:
The Mountain Resort is here! Take your family on a trip to this scenic mountain getaway and renovate this old Resort in need of repair into a popular vacation destination! AI Guests will visit and stay at the Resort, so decorate it creatively to give them a unique and enjoyable experience!

ADOPT YOUR FAMILY TODAY!

Adopt a little person from the thousands living inside your mobile device! In this life simulation game, help them choose a husband or wife and start their virtual family! Make babies and pass the house on to the kids! Help nurture and guide generations, managing your own beautiful family story.

DESIGN YOUR DREAM HOME

Expand and renovate your virtual house. Your adoptee’s new home has a lot of potential, but they need your help to fix it up! Imagine your dream home and make it a reality. Add bedrooms, a garden, a home theater, or even a game room! Collect decorations to customize and design each room.

MAKE A HAPPY, PROSPEROUS LIFE

Train your little people from babies to adulthood to take care of their home and make the best choices in life. Encourage them to work on their career and earn money for decorations, necessities, and luxuries. Upgrade your virtual family to be the best versions of themselves. Your little people will send you messages, thanking, pleading, and praising you for caring for them. Don’t forget to check in on them, because they miss you and become very sad!

LIFE SIMULATION RUNS IN REAL TIME!

Your little family continues to live, eat, grow, and work when the app is switched off. Along the way, there will be many different random events to respond to, all of them adding surprise to this simulation game and unexpected elements to routine, daily virtual life. Find highly varied, unpredictable game play. No two games run the same; the story unfolds differently for everyone who plays it. This simulation game is designed to have a life of its own!

2303770.name: Fling D'Block
2303770.about_the_game:
Beware the Obstacles as you Fling D’Block!

Fling D'Block is a physics-based precision time trial and speedrunning game that puts your skills to the ultimate test. Propel and bounce your block through a series of treacherous levels, striving to achieve the fastest time possible. Along the way, collect valuable crystals, navigate perilous obstacles, and avoid fatal mistakes.

This fast-paced game challenges your speed, dexterity, and strategy as you master each level. Sharpen your reflexes, optimize your routes, and race to the exit with flawless precision. Can you conquer the clock and claim your spot as the ultimate speedrunner?

And whatever you do… Go as Fast as You Can!

Traverse

Fling and bounce across perilous levels as you learn to master movement over time and dedication.

Avoid

Spikes, Death Wheels, Spiked Pendulums, Auto-Tracking Turrets, and Spinning Lasers. There are dangers all around you so be careful where you fling.

Create

Fling D’Block comes with a built-in level editor for those of you that wish to create fun, exciting and challenging custom levels.

2303780.name: PHOTONS
2303780.about_the_game:
Photons is a cooperative multiplayer horror game, in which you and your friends are destined to work underground, while trying to live in total darkness beneath the earth’s surface. The only way to navigate your areas is to use specialized tools, in order to control the area around you. The job is to maintain the excavation equipment, explore vast cave systems, loot for items and to not die. Succeeded tasks will be awarded in credits, with which you’ll be able to buy tools, upgrade them, and expand your base, just for the sake of a safer place to work.


Go on a trip into the dark recesses of caverns in this underground maze where light is now just a memory. To navigate through the areas, use a variety of tools, ranging from sound wave distributors, to handheld scanners that will reveal to you the nuances of the surrounding world. Remember, that you are not alone in this impenetrable darkness. Danger can lurk around every corner, and unknown creatures see you through the shadows.




Explore a network of procedurally generated caves hiding diverse biomes filled with abandoned structures and undiscovered anomalies. Watch out for increasingly dangerous threats located in the ever-distant depths of the tunnels. With randomly generated undergrounds, everyone will experience the terror of the void in a unique way.


Embark on exciting expeditions equipped with a range of practical tools and effective weaponry that you can obtain, ensuring you're well-prepared for the challenges of exploration and combat in uncharted territories. Equip surface scanners to map your environment, available in different forms like handheld devices or scanning grenades, helping you understand and navigate your surroundings. Set up stationary machinery for strategic exploration to unravel larger areas and aid in strategizing your exploration efforts, or go mobile with the assistance of autonomous robotic helpers. Customize your weapons with a user-friendly attachment system and keep track of your equipment using a personal tablet, making inventory management straightforward and effective.




In the meantime, you can fight your friends in various Arcade experiences like classic Deathmatch to more tactical one’s like Team Deathmatch. There are plenty of them, and they could serve as a “break” from the horrors that are waiting for you in the real game.

2303800.name: My Life as a Cult Leader
2303800.about_the_game:
When a terrible turn of events causes you to lose your job and get evicted from your apartment, you're left with nothing to your name. You find yourself on a cold park bench, miserable and exhausted with nowhere else to turn. As you curse your fate, dark thoughts cloud your mind, wishing things would turn out differently. Suddenly, a mysterious woman approaches you, introducing herself as Shima Itsuki and asking you to take over as the new leader of a cult. She explains that their current leader is dying and needs you to act as a substitute. With nothing to lose and an empty stomach to fill, you decide to take her up on her offer, but who would've guessed the sort of cult you'd end up leading...

A Thrilling Mystery to Unravel

What's Shima's true aim? What put your predecessor on his deathbed? Seek the answers to the many questions surrounding your cult as you tend to your followers and juggle your daily duties!

A Fierce Battle for Survival

Unfortunately, running a cult isn't all fun and games. External forces threaten your cult's very existence at every turn. Thwart those who challenge your authority and let nothing stop your rise to power!

Gorgeous Character Art

Fall in love with this colorful cast of characters and the beautiful, expressive art that brings them to life and lets their personalities shine!

2303810.name: Obscurite Magie: The Blood of Kings
2303810.about_the_game:
Fifteen years ago, the ruler of the Giselian Empire was deposed in a coup d'etat. The current ruler, Valon, imposes heavy taxes on the people, but the imperial army is strong and the nation is secure. The people suffer from the steep taxes, but very few dare speak out.

Lietta Fane is a girl who works as an adventurer in the Giselian Empire. She was raised by her swordmaster Negel for as long as she can remember. She never knew her parents. In addition to her adventurer work, she's also searching for the person who killed Negel.

One day she receives a request from the guild to escort a nobleman. On the way to their destination, she is attacked, and must now confront her destiny...

Take off for adventure through the Giselian Empire while uncovering the truth behind Negel's murder in this timeless turn-based RPG. Face off against a diverse set of enemies and bosses, discover and gain a wide variety of loot, and level up to overpower your foes!

2303820.name: VERUM
2303820.about_the_game:
Introducing VERUM - an interactive experience that will challenge the way you see the world. This game goes beyond just entertainment and invites players to explore important ethical issues surrounding giant tech corporations and the usage of personal data by companies and governments.

Through VERUM's gameplay, you will embark on a journey to understand the story behind the game. As you progress, you will encounter multiple side stories that cover different aspects of the main plot and present different perspectives. By seeing the same plot through these different lenses, you will gain a more diverse understanding of the topics presented.

Each side story consists of a series of scenes followed by unique endings, providing valuable information for players to understand the main plot. The best part? The player can visualize these endings in any order without respecting their chronological timeline.

As the player traverses through unique scenes related to side stories, they will unlock one of VERUM's multiple endings. The game always starts (restarts) at the same initial scene, and the player can jump between side stories to reach different endings.

VERUM's gameplay is simple yet immersive. Players must find a gate to move from one scene to another, and interaction with these gates is as simple as a click or click and hold. The narrative of each scene gives a clue to what that specific scene represents and indicates what can be a gate there.

With its beautiful and captivating graphics, VERUM is an experience like no other. It challenges players to question their own beliefs and to look at the same topic from different perspectives. There are no right or wrong answers, only valuable insights that will leave you thinking long after the game is over.

Are you ready to challenge your beliefs and explore the world of VERUM? Get ready to dive into this thought-provoking experience and unlock multiple endings to uncover the full story.

2303850.name: Toxic Crusaders
2303850.about_the_game:
Toxic Crusaders is an action-packed beat 'em up game where players take control of one of seven playable characters, each with their own unique moves and abilities. The game features up to four-player, local co-op -- allowing friends to team up and take on hordes of Radiation Rangers, mutated thugs, and zombie chickens across seven disgusting levels, rendered in beautiful full-color pixel-art graphics.

FOUR PLAYERS AND SEVEN PLAYABLE CHARACTERS

Toxic Crusaders allows up to four players to battle together in local co-op, making it a perfect game for a group of friends. Players can choose from seven playable characters, each with their own unique moves and powers, including the beloved Toxie, No-Zone, Junkyard, Major Disaster, Headbanger, and (for the first time) Yvonne and Mrs. Junko!

FIGHT THROUGH CARTOON AND MOVIE LEVELS

Season 2 of the 1990s Toxic Crusaders cartoon sadly never happened, but this game continues the cartoon's plot! This original storyline is also packed with references to the iconic Troma cult movies, complete with hilarious Easter eggs and cameos from fan-favorite characters. Whether you're a die-hard Troma fan or a newcomer, you'll enjoy the off-beat humor.

FULLY VOICE ACTED WITH MOTION COMICS CUTSCENES

Toxic Crusaders features fully voice-acted motion comic cutscenes that add depth and immersion to the game's story, creating a cohesive and immersive experience that will keep players engaged from start to finish. Voice acting by TeamFourStar, industry veterans, and actual Troma film actors.

FULLY APPROVED BY LLOYD KAUFMAN AND THE ANGRY VIDEO GAME NERD!!

2303910.name: Chrono Rift
2303910.about_the_game:
Step into the shoes of a wizard in Chrono Rift and embark on a thrilling adventure to defend the world from monster invasions caused by mysterious spatiotemporal breaches! Join the Breach Hunter Guild and team up with other players online to take on the challenge. With a mix of fantasy, action, and roguelike elements, get ready to unleash your magic and destroy the breaches before it's too late. Will you be the one to uncover the truth behind this crazy phenomenon and save the world? Play Chrono Rift now!

Replay the game an infinite amount of time by testing different combinations of spells and effect. Wanna go full DPS? Then get the "duplicate projectile" effect to multiply your damage! Wanna deal massive damage to a large crowd of enemies? Why not opt for the "projectile ricochet" effect and AOE spells! Each enemies have elemental strength and weaknesses. Choose your elemental type of damage wisely depending on your teammates and the opponents you will be facing.

It is your duty as Breach Hunters to face invaders of different universes and timelines. Determined to destroy your kingdom, an evil entity opens portals to realms where all sorts of evil creatures reside: Zombies, Aliens, Robots, Orcs and even Pirates! Each of these species have their own behaviors and will use different tactics to try to destroy you. Zombies are slows but numerous melee foes. Aliens are fast but afraid of fire. Robots use futuristic tech and more tactical strategies. Orcs are walking tanks who gets close and personal with his enemies. Finally, pirates are... Well they are pirates!

Team up with up to 3 other Breach Hunters and stop the evils that are invading your realm!

Purchase of this game contains the main game only.

2303940.name: Head Coach Tactics
2303940.about_the_game:
Head Coach Tactics uses a unique combination of real-time animation and turn-based strategy to create an exciting and strategic brand of football. It makes you think about your moves on the field, but doesn't make it boring.



The process is simple, but also tactically deep. You call the plays by selecting a personnel package and formation to send out onto the field. At the snap, the game's real-time animation takes over and simulates the first couple seconds of the play as a way to making sure you always have something interesting and new to start with. Then, the turn-based part kicks in, and you need to figure out how to get the most out of your players, given the situation on the field.



The unique style of tactics is an effective balance of decision making and simplicity. Something like the passing game in football can be exciting, so we tried to pull out all the unneeded complexity and focus on the strategy. Everything can be done with just a couple clicks! This allows you to focus on what really matters, which is putting your players in situations with the best matchups.



For those who love a power running game, we got you covered too! Running the game has been made just as fun as the passing game. Blocking is an important part of running the ball effectively, so you'll need to plan out your moves to create running lanes for your star RB. If everything goes according to plan, you could end up with massive holes and dominating on the ground!

Roster Building and Franchise!


Your success on the field depends largely on your ability to field a great team. To that end, we've created a robust franchise mode for you to craft your team to play the style of football you love.





Whether it's drafting players for the future, signing that high-priced free agent for right now, or making trades to reshape the franchise, you have a deep and exciting franchise mode to flex your strategic muscles. Each phase of building your roster has been designed to provide a strategic challenge, but in a way that is easy to understand and not overly complicated. We've taken the approach that a streamlines and focused roster-building experience is more fun than complicated systems that are hard to understand. Since you will intuitively know what's important for each phase, you can spend all your energy coming up with the best strategy.

Even though we've streamlined franchise mode, we made sure to keep it deep and engaging. The other teams will always be looking for a edge, and keeping all your star players is going to be difficult. Sometimes you're going to have to make hard choices in order to assure long-term franchise health!

Turn-Based Football?

Why turn-based football? Well, it's something that hasn't really been done before. If you think about it, there's so much strategy that happens on the football field during a play. All the micro-second decisions that every player makes, how each player works within the system, and how the individual matchups play out, feels like it's the perfect candidate for a turn-based strategy game. We want to really explore what happens within a play, but in a deliberate fashion.
