2304090.name: Wars of Cards: ROMA
2304090.about_the_game:
Hello everyone. Wars of Cards: ROMA is a multiplayer strategy game created by our small team. Compared with the high-fidelity, brain-burning strategy game masterpieces produced by big companies, Wars of Cards adopts a minimalist gameplay of maps and cards, which can easily satisfy the desire of strategy lovers to color the map.

The background of the game is the late period of the Roman republic. The sudden death of the former dictator plunged the city of Rome into a power vacuum and chaos. Governors with some ideas raised troops everywhere in the name of the Senate and the Roman people.

The game is turn-based. Multiple players start the game from the base camps of their respective starting plots. Each player starts with 4 cards, and draws another 1 card each round. When it’s your turn to play cards, just choose which cards to play and where to attack and you’re done. After the defender also plays cards, the system will automatically calculate the outcome of the battle. Capturing another player’s stronghold can annex their entire territory. On the contrary, if the base camp is occupied by other players, they will be eliminated and can only watch the battle. According to our tests, it takes about thirty minutes for four players to complete a round. Yes, thirty minutes, make Rome great again!

Cards are divided into troop cards, general cards, auxiliary cards, and special cards. Simply speaking, in a set of cards, the command value of a general card multiplied by the sum of the attack value or defense value of all troop cards is the combat power of this set of cards. Auxiliary cards will provide additional bonuses to the value of troop cards and general cards. Each special card has its own special way of playing. For example, when the defense fails, the Vestal Virgin can persuade the opponent to surrender a card; the Chief High Priest will prevent the battle; the Senate will encourage military expansion or force sanctions, etc.

At the beginning of the game, there are many neutral plots on the map, which represent small groups of separatist forces. Some plots have clan logos on them. If you have such a land, after the cards belonging to the clan are played, as long as the battle is won, they can be returned to the hand.

The maximum number of cards you can hold is 5. When each neutral plot is occupied for the first time, the occupant can draw an extra card. However, if the occupant’s hand is full at this time, no cards will be drawn.

All territories must have access to the base camp. If the road between the two is severed, the resulting enclave becomes a neutral plot. The neutral plot is darker in color than a neutral plot that has never been occupied, and a player who recapturing that plot does not gain additional draws. If territory is found to be cut off or the base camp is at risk of falling, you can choose to move the base camp earlier.

There is a saying that a tiger is hard against a pack of wolves. Diplomacy is also a big factor in winning the game. Players in the game can type and chat. How to avoid multi-line combat depends on your diplomatic communication skills.

The above is a brief introduction to the gameplay of the strategy game Wars of Cards: ROMA. In addition to playing against humans, you can also choose AI as your opponent.

If the game can get initial approval from all players, then we will make more maps, cards and upgraded gameplay, and even mods with new themes in the future.
We welcome your suggestions for improving the game. We look forward to meeting and learning from each other in the multiplayer battle of Wars of Cards: Rome.

Do you enjoy playing around with the physics in games? Then this is the game for you. Stack Masters is built around exploring that concept in a competitive way. Including a built in level editor and Steam Workshop support, the game offers a never ending supply of physics sandbox gameplay to explore.

Compete to build crazy structures in order to climb the leaderboards or simply work your way through over 100 levels to beat the campaign.


A low price was always the plan but that does not mean low quality.

We want you to be able to buy the game whenever you want, without needing to wait for a sale, or to grab a bunch of copies and share them with friends so you can all compete for the top spot on the leaderboards.



However you choose to play the game, we want you to play the game, and didn't want price to ever be an issue.

Oh, and don't worry, there are no microtransations either.



Nope, far from it. The game is split into different categories each exploring a different game mechanic or theme.



You'll start with the simplest of towers, but you'll soon be dealing with drop zones, time manipulation, logic puzzles, gravity sliders, multi-zones, pivot blocks, ungrabbable blocks, interlocking blocks, bridges, weights and even a level built to play like a pachinko machine.

There are over one hundred levels already and we've only just begun to scratch the surface of what's possible.

Better yet, everyone can explore those possibilities with an in-game level editor. See below for details.


Play together with children to teach them the basics of physics, or use your engineering degree to push things to the extreme.

Every category contains a selection of levels, from easy to hard, to allow everyone to explore the whole game.



You only need to beat one or two levels in each category to unlock the next, which allows players from all skill levels to easily progress through the game and explore the different themes and game mechanics.

Most levels are designed to be solvable in anything from five to thirty minutes but if you want to compete for the best possible scores you can expect to spend hours on each level in order to find the ultimate solution.


Each level can have up to three leaderboards, allowing you to compete with your Steam friends or push yourself towards a world record for ultimate glory.


Every level was built using the game's super easy to use level editor. A single click of a button can allow you to begin editing the level you are currently playing or to start a brand new one from scratch.

Choose an arena, choose a location, choose from hundreds of block shapes, drag and drop them wherever you like, and start playing your creation instantly right there in the editor. A couple of clicks and you've added a new goal zone. A couple of drags and you resized and moved it to the perfect position.

Want a new wall here or there? No problem. Click click.
Want a drop zone here, or to change a block to a different type? No problem. Click click.



Once done, you can share your levels instantly via the Steam Workshop.


Two clicks is all it takes to upload your creations, and one click to download each new community created level you want to play. It couldn't be easier.




Have you got what it takes to become the next Stack Master?

2305110.name: Photon Engineer
2305110.about_the_game:
Gameplay

During your journey, you will be confronted with a variety of original and challenging puzzles. You will be required to form ingenious systems by building blocks having different abilities, such as deflecting and merging laser beams, turning and pushing other blocks.

Unleash your creativity and problem-solving skills to progress through the game, unravel the mysteries of your surroundings and unlock new information as you delve deeper into the unknown.

The laser puzzles are interspersed with sliding puzzles that require strategic moves to solve.

Story

In 2075, a space probe saw a strange platform floating in space near Jupiter. The government has decided to finance a space mission to send you on this platform to elucidate the mystery. Your mission is to discover why this platform exists and who built it.

Further details

  • 40 levels/platforms to discover.
  • 95 puzzles (45 puzzles with lasers and 50 sliding puzzles).
  • 20 puzzle achievements that extend the game experience.
  • Each puzzle is unique and provides a new idea.
  • Lasers are all marked with symbols for colorblind players.
2305110.supported_languages: English, French, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America

2305130.name: The Danger Zone
2305130.about_the_game:
Discover the new game universe of The Danger Zone:

  • A unique gameplay based shooter with side view, horror elements and immersive survival mechanics in a post-apocalypse setting.

  • Free Game Mode: A huge, uninhabited concrete shelter in which the player has to set up his life.

  • A world map with lots of sub-locations and points of interest. Explore unique, memorable places, discover hidden locations and geocaches.

  • Realistic and scenic environments. Changing weather, the cycle of day and night will increase immersion in the setting.

  • Realistic artificial intelligence systems that are on par with the constant lack of ammunition will keep even the most hardened players in suspense.

  • Over 200 in-game items and gear.

  • A large arsenal of weapons and a modding system.

Welcome to the new world

After thousands of intercontinental nuclear missiles had split the earth, enough time had passed: the era of eternal and cold winters was gone. The radioactive background has slowly drifted downward. And the people who had been living in underground shelters for a dozen years opened the gates of the seals again, smoldering with the hope of regaining control over the previously destroyed and lost world.

And in the end, we ended up back in the bunker

Having broken out of the underground dungeon, we were once again buried under a dense layer of earth in a concrete box - a bunker. It's dark, wet and incredibly cold. We're here for the long haul, so it would be nice to set up our new home and finally fix the hole in this rusty pipe.

This oppressive sky

As a result of global conflict, the world has undergone major changes. By pressing the red buttons, the leaders of the superpowers did not hesitate to exchange the most advanced means of destruction. The previously white-blue sky was forever colored in bright yellow shades, the radioactive background jumped dozens of times, and the district was filled with previously unknown and not very friendly creatures.

Outside the asylum is a huge open world

Around the refuge stretches a massive uncharted territory. Behind the edge of the forest area there may be a small abandoned village or a huge city, where everyone will find what they are looking for.

Attention! The global map will be changed and supplemented in each major content update.

There's danger all around

Widespread radioactive contamination is only one of the consequences of nuclear conflict. In addition to nuclear weapons, previously banned biological weapons have changed the fauna around you. Prepare to encounter creepy, frightening, and very unfriendly creatures along the way.

Every rifle is important

In a world where every piece of small arms is of great value, it is important to keep an eye on your equipment. The most detailed system of modifications will allow you to create a truly devastating means of defeat, even from weapons that have served their time. In pursuit of expanding the capabilities of their weapons can change anything. All accessories are based on real or close to real weapon prototypes and mods, which makes the game even more realistic.

2305160.name: Manabi SandBox
2305160.about_the_game:
Puzzle action game Manabi Sandbox


This is an action game in which you control a knight and explore unknown ruins.
The objective is to collect all the fruits on the map while exterminating monsters.
Overcome various difficulties with simple actions and ingenuity. You can also clear the game by jumping alone.
The knight never dies, so don't give up and solve all the puzzles.
The player's point of view hardly moves, so players who get drunk when playing 3D action games can enjoy the game without worry.

Game Controls


■Keyboard & Mouse
Quit （終了）: esc
Jump:Space
Move:WASD
Shot:R-Shift , R-Ctrl , LMB
Cam:←↑↓→ , Mouse Move
Restart : R


■Game Pad
Move:　Left Analog Stick
Shot:Y
Jump:B
Cam:Right Analog Stick
Restart : R1+L1

Features


Fruits
Fruits disappear upon contact or shot.
The number of remaining on the field is indicated by the UI.

Monsters
Beastmen and dragons stand in your way. They can be very damaging, but they always have a weak spot somewhere, and you can defeat them with a shot.
Sometimes you need to be tactful and move on without fighting.

moving floor
When you get on a moving floor, you can move to another stage. Some floors even move on contact.

Stones that can be moved
There are stones that can be moved by hitting them with your body. Even if you think you are trapped in a room, do not give up and find a way to get out.

Player Controls


Jump (Space)
Most obstacles on the field can be overcome by jumping.
Sometimes, a large jump can be made by using the moving floor.

Shot (R-Ctrl,R-Shift）
You can catch fruits or defeat monsters. You cannot shoot continuously, so please aim at the target well. You can adjust the trajectory by moving the camera.

Camera（←↑↓→）
Sometimes you want to look around, but you can hardly move the camera. This is because I sometimes get drunk when I operate the camera in 3D action games.

About clearing games


Play time is 5 to 10 minutes, so feel free to play.
Once you take all the fruits, you will have the ending of the game. After that, you can try as many times as you want.

2305180.name: You are the Judge!
2305180.about_the_game:
YOU ARE THE JUDGE!

For years, Kobardde has been the scene of various conflicts. You witnessed a lot of these conflicts in your youth. This situation in your country is one of the biggest reasons for your fondness for the concepts of justice and law. You have now concluded your long and successful career as a lawyer and are about to begin your first day of employment as a judge. You will examine dozens of realistic, complex, and carefully prepared case files, consult witnesses and try to make a decision. In your decision-making process, you will become familiar with the various factors in your country. The decisions you make will directly affect the lives of one or both parties to the case. The decisions you make over time can directly impact your life. What kind of a career as a judge will you pursue?

WHO IS THE RICHARD ANDERSON?

Your career as a judge is directly related to your past life. For this reason, the game starts with a story where you will make choices based on the events in your country and your life, from Richard's youth to the day he passed the judge's exam. Your preferences will be effective in your career as a judge. This is an excellent opportunity for you to shape your career.

WHO WILL CHALLENGE YOU THE MOST?

Kobardde got a new order after many years. Your role as a judge in this order puts you in a powerful position. However, there may be parties that may feel uncomfortable with your position. Although your decisions ease your conscience, they may not be considered appropriate by various segments. There will be situations where you will have to choose how much to compromise your values when deciding. You must identify your friends and foes for a long career as a judge.

HOW WILL YOU DECIDE?

  • Feel like a real judge with carefully prepared case files of tens of thousands of words inspired by actual events.
  • Experience a unique courtroom experience with realistic scene designs and animations.
  • The choices you make will take you to different ends of the game, have the chance to experience each one.
  • Resolve case files prepared with bribery and many other unique mechanics.
  • See the direct impact of the decisions and choices you make on your judge career.
2305180.supported_languages:
English*, Turkish, Russian, German
*languages with full audio support

2305190.name: Limbo Control
2305190.about_the_game:
Limbo Control — a tense asymmetric multiplayer horror experience (1v4).

One player becomes the Entity — an otherworldly force that has broken into reality. The other four are SSA agents, elite operatives sent to reclaim a location that’s slipping out of control.

Every match is a fight for territory and survival.

You are a supernatural creature, slowly takes over the world around you.

Manipulate the environment, sow fear, and expand your influence until nothing remains but your domain.

Key Features:

  • Begin as an invisible force, warping reality from the shadows

  • Trigger haunting events, set traps, and sabotage the agents' plans

  • Gather power and manifest physically to begin the hunt

  • Choose your path to victory: dominate the territory or eliminate resistance

You are part of an elite response team tasked with containing the anomaly and banishing the Entity.

Stay sharp, adapt fast, and take back the space before it’s too late.

Key Features:

  • Operate as a team or split up to complete critical objectives

  • Scan anomalies to uncover distortions in reality

  • Repair infrastructure to stabilize the environment

  • Use SSA technology to locate and weaken the Entity

2305210.name: Skyformer
2305210.about_the_game:
You are a robot sent to a planet to set up a system to make it habitable for your creators:

  • Design factories run by drones.

  • Create bases to craft and shelter in.

  • Upgrade your abilities and terraform to expand the area you can explore. You have both a health and charge meter that can get heavily upgraded over time. 

  • Set up systems to monitor storms and deploy resources to protect buildings in their path.

  • Build out a skybase that houses a data center and launches rockets.

  • Discover and grow various plants and stabilize the climate to make the planet habitable. Watch as the visibility increases to reveal your creation and the planet transforms dramatically from a barren to lush environment.

Build factories automated entirely by drones!

Create systems to mine and process materials in automated pipelines. Configure drones to easily handle the logistics.

Skyformer’s automation is different from that of similar games. Resource deposits provide an infinite supply of resources, but as you get further into the game it challenges and rewards you for utilizing the production rates that you have and the entire map the best that you can. At the same time, it keeps calculations straightforward with simple ratios and round numbers. There are also quality of life features that make it easy to understand what's going on; you can come back to old saves and quickly pick up where you left off.

Terraform and track the weather!

The processed materials allow you to create and run a system that controls the climate, tracks the weather, and terraforms the planet. As you terraform, the planet becomes more capable of producing weather systems, some of which being quite destructive. This game has a dynamic weather system that interacts with the geography, producing microclimates in each region based on the current global climate.

Survive the process and achieve habitability!

Changing the climate of the planet can allow access to previously inhospitable regions, but can also do the opposite. Observing the weather and how the geography influences it is important to surviving the terraforming process. A blend of strategies can be used to survive storms, such as building up an expansive automated drone defense system, strategically positioning buildings, or simply maximizing the power of your tools and taking storms head-on. The energy produced by the storms can also be harnessed!

The goal of the game is to achieve a climate that maximizes biomass across each region, and stabilize the atmosphere to the point at which storms are no longer destructive.

Development

Skyformer is a debut game made with passion with both the game engine and all the art handmade by one developer over several years. It's being worked on intensely to 1.0 in 2026!

Music and sound by Marty Meinerz.
2305210.supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Russian, French, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Spain

2305310.name: Blind and Schizophrenic
2305310.about_the_game:
Sixty-nine year old Richard Cox is a washed up schizophrenic, who also happens to be blind on account of his constant absinthe consumption. Worse still, fate forces him to prolong his pitiful existence in spite of his handicaps. The only thing left to chance now is how he will spend the little time he has left......

- Explore the dark streets of your hometown using primarily sound and your schizophrenia

- Survive as many days as you can without dying or going insane

- See how much respect you can accumulate by completing quests for the denizens of the town, or by indulging in your own vices

- Smoke weed, collect welfare, or just shoot up the town, it's your sandbox!


What would you do if you were blind and schizophrenic?

2305320.name: 平凡的我與幽靈的同居生活
2305320.about_the_game:
《平凡的我與幽靈的同居生活》是講述一位青年因命運的安排而住進了一間存在幽靈的房間，並與該幽靈展開同居生活的戀愛題材的視覺小說遊戲。



故事簡介
物部才人在參加完父母的葬禮後回到家裡，但由於才人打算到東京找工作，於是便到東京尋找新居住的地方，在找了幾天後才人終於找到了一個便宜而且不錯的地方，因此爽快簽約並從原先的地方搬走，但入住後靈異事件不斷，打電話詢問經紀才知道這裡的上一手女主人死在這裡，簽約前也有跟主角說過，這時主角也隱約記起，就這樣開始了與幽靈的同居生活。


伊藤綾瀨
在才人搬過來之前的一年在家中死去，對於自己為什麼突然間離世沒有記憶，而且在此之後就一直待在這裡，也沒辦法離開，一直以來都是自己一個人，直至才人搬過來
擅長照顧人，而且因為自己一個人太久了，因此遇到才人後偶爾會捉弄一下他，與自己的媽媽吵架後獨自搬了出來

本作可攻略角色只有伊藤綾瀨，劇情為單向路線

本作遊戲時長大約為兩個小時







企劃&製作人：近火
劇本：近火
原畫：大白HT
編程：GAMLIC Studio

2305330.name: Car Dealer's Life
2305330.about_the_game:
Do you want to come to this city? Let me tell you from the beginning that this city has its own unique rules. If you want to do car trading in this city, you need to establish a company and obtain a license. After doing these, it would be nice to buy yourself a gallery. If your money is not enough, it's easy to get a loan from a bank. You can start trading by buying one of the cars for sale on the city's streets. Everyone's story starts on the streets anyway. Would you like me to give you more information? Sure, but first click on the Wishlist button above to follow me.If you follow me, I already share everything that's happening in the city, so you can learn from there.


While you are driving around the city with your car, you can go hunting for vehicles, if you haven't bought a house yet, you can go to a hotel and spend the night. Since you will spend a lot of time in the city with your car, a fast vehicle will return to you as more snow.



Develop your showroom and ensure that more customers visit you. Seize the opportunity to earn more income with the additional features you will gain.



Customize your cars and sell them at a higher price. Selling customized cars will gain you popularity in the city and bring you customers who want to customize their cars.




Looking for some excitement? Then the black market is just for you. Some cars can only be obtained through the black market.
Remember, these vehicles are illegal and there is always a risk of being scammed while trying to obtain them!




The city junkyard will be an essential destination for you. You will obtain the parts you need for vehicle repairs from here.


    KEY FEATURES
  • You can drive any car that belongs to you, and having a fast car while driving around the city can help you earn more money.
  • Selling a car directly may not always yield a good profit. You can make more money by repairing or customizing a car, or even obtaining a rental license to rent it out.
  • Some cars may have a much higher actual value, and you need to work with an expert company to learn about it.
  • You need to have a license for many operations you will perform in the city, and you can do any job that you can obtain a license for. While some licenses are easy to obtain, for others, you need to win an auction.
  • You will participate in auctions and bid at many points in the game, which may be for a lost profession license or a seized car.
  • You can improve your garage, and these improvements will give you extra features.
  • It is possible to make money through some illegal methods in the game, such as stealing cars at night and selling them. You can see more in the game.
  • You can reduce your workload in the game by finding colleagues to work with.

2305360.name: Velo
2305360.about_the_game:
Velo is a unique cycling game that combines the thrill of virtual cycling with an engaging story-driven experience. Unlike other cycling games, Velo is a single-player adventure that takes you on a journey through a beautifully crafted virtual world, filled with stunning scenery and compelling characters.

Using smart trainers connected via Bluetooth, players must pedal their way through the game's challenging terrain, unlocking new areas and missions as they progress through the game's story. With a variety of missions and quests to complete, players will be challenged both physically and mentally as they explore the game's world.

The story of Velo is immersive and captivating, with a cast of characters and a richly detailed world that will keep players engaged and motivated to keep pedaling. With each mission, players will uncover more of the game's story, unlocking new areas and discovering the secrets hidden within the game's world.

No schedules, no training plans, no workouts, no competitions, just the joy of riding through a beautiful world while delivering important packages to its inhabitants. Velo is the perfect game for anyone looking for a way to stay active that is so fun to play that it draws them back in.

So if you're ready for a cycling adventure like no other, it's time to start your journey through this exciting new world.
